name: Ryoujoku Idol Mesu Dorei ~Higyaku no Tokubetsu Lesson~
original_name: 凌辱アイドル牝奴隷～被虐の特別レッスン～
source:
Main character is a president of a small entertainment production company with a firm standing. He acquired this position by training idols into sex slaves and presenting them to powerful people. Now he receives a new request, so he starts looking for a suitable prey.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一家地位稳固的小型娱乐制作公司的总裁。他通过将偶像训练成性奴隶并将其呈现给有权势的人来获得这一地位。现在他收到了新的请求，于是他开始寻找合适的猎物。
